'''Dorindha''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Jindo]] [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].

== Appearance ==
She has red hair and is [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s age.

== Activities ==
She was one of the [[Aiel]] in the [[Stone of Tear]] when it fell. She was one of the Maidens who talked [[Matrim Cauthon]] into playing [[Maiden's Kiss]]. She is with [[Rand al'Thor]] when he sets out from [[Rhuidean]].{{ref/book|4|36}}
